fusions.name: Hull-Breaker
fusions.desc: Deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Reef Rash
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 3 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each affliction already on the target (max 40%).

fusions.name: Raised Shoal
fusions.desc: Raises a ridge of reef 5 tiles long in front of you for 8 seconds. It deals 4 damage to anything that crosses it and leaves it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Encrusted by Blows
fusions.desc: Every hit you land adds a stack, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (34% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
